name: inoreader
label: Inoreader
description: Inoreader is a cloud RSS/Atom aggregator. This connector reads subscriptions, folders, and article streams over the Inoreader Reader API, marks articles read or starred, and ingests new articles on a schedule so playbooks can act on feed-driven intelligence (vendor release notes, advisories, vulnerability disclosures) without parsing RSS dialects.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.description: Base URL of the Inoreader service. Leave at the default unless you are pointed at a regional endpoint.
fields.tooltip: Base URL of the Inoreader service.

fields.title: App ID
fields.name: app_id
fields.description: The App ID issued when you registered your application at https://www.inoreader.com/developers/register-app. Sent in the AppId header; Inoreader's daily rate-limit quota is counted against it.
fields.tooltip: App ID from your registered Inoreader application.

fields.title: App Key
fields.name: app_key
fields.description: The App Key issued with the App ID. Sent in the AppKey header.
fields.tooltip: App Key from your registered Inoreader application.

fields.title: OAuth Client ID
fields.name: client_id
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID of your Inoreader application. For most registrations this is the same value as the App ID.

fields.title: OAuth Client Secret
fields.name: client_secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret of your Inoreader application. For most registrations this is the same value as the App Key.

fields.title: Refresh Token
fields.name: refresh_token
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token obtained once, out of band, by completing the authorization-code flow against https://www.inoreader.com/oauth2/auth with scope 'read' (or 'read write' if you intend to mark articles read, star them, or subscribe to feeds). The connector exchanges it for a short-lived access token and caches that token on this configuration. If Inoreader rotates the refresh token, the connector writes the new one back here automatically.
fields.tooltip: OAuth 2.0 refresh token for the Inoreader account whose feeds you want to read.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Whether the SSL certificate of the server is to be validated. Defaults to true.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Stream ID
ingestion_config_schema.name: stream_id
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Stream to ingest: 'user/-/state/com.google/reading-list' for everything, 'user/-/label/FOLDER' for one folder, or 'feed/<feed url>' for a single feed.
ingestion_config_schema.description: Stream to ingest. Use 'user/-/state/com.google/reading-list' for all subscriptions, 'user/-/label/<Folder>' for a folder, or 'feed/<feed url>' for a single feed. A bare feed URL is accepted and prefixed for you.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Ingestion Begin From
ingestion_config_schema.name: last_pull_datetime
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Ingest articles published after this datetime. Subsequent runs continue from the last pull time.
ingestion_config_schema.description: Ingest articles published after this datetime.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Unread Articles Only
ingestion_config_schema.name: unread_only
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Exclude articles already marked read in Inoreader.
ingestion_config_schema.description: Exclude articles already marked as read in Inoreader.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Mark Ingested Articles as Read
ingestion_config_schema.name: mark_as_read
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Mark each ingested article read, so 'Unread Articles Only' becomes the de-duplication ledger. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope, and spends Zone 2 quota.
ingestion_config_schema.description: Mark each ingested article as read after it is pulled. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Maximum Articles per Pull
ingestion_config_schema.name: max_records
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Hard stop on articles per run. Inoreader returns at most 100 per request, so 500 here costs 5 requests against a DAILY quota.
ingestion_config_schema.description: Maximum number of articles to pull per run. Each 100 articles costs one API request against Inoreader's daily quota.

operations.title: Fetch Articles
operations.description: Retrieves articles from an Inoreader stream published after a given time, optionally restricted to unread articles. This is the operation used by scheduled Data Ingestion.

parameters.title: Stream ID
parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.tooltip: Stream to read. Defaults to the full reading list. A bare feed URL is accepted and prefixed with 'feed/' for you.
parameters.description: Stream to read, e.g. 'user/-/state/com.google/reading-list', 'user/-/label/Patch Intel', or 'feed/https://example.com/releases.atom'. Defaults to the full reading list.

parameters.title: Published After
parameters.name: last_pull_datetime
parameters.tooltip: Only return articles published after this datetime.
parameters.description: Only return articles published after this datetime.

parameters.title: Unread Articles Only
parameters.name: unread_only
parameters.tooltip: Exclude articles already marked read.
parameters.description: Exclude articles already marked as read in Inoreader.

parameters.title: Mark Ingested Articles as Read
parameters.name: mark_as_read
parameters.tooltip: Mark each returned article read. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.
parameters.description: Mark each returned article as read after it is pulled. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

parameters.title: Maximum Articles
parameters.name: max_records
parameters.tooltip: Hard stop on the number of articles returned.
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Each 100 costs one API request.

operations.title: Get Stream Contents
operations.description: Retrieves full article content from a stream (a feed, a folder, or a system state such as starred), with server-side filtering and pagination.

parameters.title: Stream ID
parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.tooltip: Stream to read. Leave blank to use the Stream Type below.
parameters.description: Stream to read, e.g. 'feed/https://example.com/releases.atom' or 'user/-/label/Patch Intel'. Leave blank to use the Stream Type below.

parameters.title: Stream Type
parameters.name: stream_type
parameters.tooltip: Used only when Stream ID is blank. Ignored otherwise; if both are blank the full reading list is read.
parameters.description: System stream to read when Stream ID is blank. If both are blank, the full reading list is read.

parameters.title: Published After
parameters.name: start_time
parameters.tooltip: Only return articles published after this datetime.
parameters.description: Only return articles published after this datetime.

parameters.title: Unread Articles Only
parameters.name: unread_only
parameters.tooltip: Exclude articles already marked read.
parameters.description: Exclude articles already marked as read in Inoreader.

parameters.title: Oldest First
parameters.name: oldest_first
parameters.tooltip: Return oldest articles first instead of newest first.
parameters.description: Return oldest articles first instead of newest first.

parameters.title: Include Only Articles Tagged
parameters.name: include_tag
parameters.tooltip: Restrict results to articles carrying this system tag.
parameters.description: Restrict results to articles carrying this system tag.

parameters.title: Include Only Articles In Folder/Tag
parameters.name: include_custom_tag
parameters.tooltip: Folder or tag name, or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID. Overrides the selection above.
parameters.description: Restrict results to articles in this folder or tag. Accepts a plain name or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.

parameters.title: Include Annotations
parameters.name: include_annotations
parameters.tooltip: Include user annotations on each article.
parameters.description: Include user annotations on each article.

parameters.title: Maximum Articles
parameters.name: max_records
parameters.tooltip: Hard stop on the number of articles returned; the connector pages until it is reached.
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Inoreader returns at most 100 per request, so this many/100 requests are spent against the daily quota.

operations.title: Get Article IDs
operations.description: Retrieves only the article IDs and timestamps for a stream. Much cheaper than fetching content, and the right way to check 'is there anything new' before spending quota on full articles.

parameters.title: Stream ID
parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.tooltip: Stream to read. Defaults to the full reading list.
parameters.description: Stream to read. Defaults to the full reading list.

parameters.title: Published After
parameters.name: start_time
parameters.tooltip: Only return articles published after this datetime.
parameters.description: Only return articles published after this datetime.

parameters.title: Unread Articles Only
parameters.name: unread_only
parameters.tooltip: Exclude articles already marked read.
parameters.description: Exclude articles already marked as read in Inoreader.

parameters.title: Oldest First
parameters.name: oldest_first
parameters.tooltip: Return oldest articles first instead of newest first.
parameters.description: Return oldest articles first instead of newest first.

parameters.title: Exclude Folder Tags
parameters.name: exclude_folder_tags
parameters.tooltip: Omit the directStreamIds folder list from each result.
parameters.description: Omit the folder/tag IDs attached to each article reference.

parameters.title: Maximum Article IDs
parameters.name: max_records
parameters.tooltip: Hard stop on the number of IDs returned. This endpoint returns up to 1000 per request.
parameters.description: Maximum number of article IDs to return. This endpoint returns up to 1000 per request.

operations.title: Get Subscriptions
operations.description: Retrieves every feed the account is subscribed to, with its ID, title, folders, and feed URL.

parameters.title: Include Team Channels
parameters.name: include_team_assets
parameters.tooltip: Include team channels in the result.
parameters.description: Include team channels in the result.

operations.title: Get Folders and Tags
operations.description: Retrieves the account's folders, tags, and active searches, optionally with unread counts.

parameters.title: Include Unread Counts
parameters.name: include_counts
parameters.tooltip: Include unread and unseen counts per tag.
parameters.description: Include unread and unseen counts per tag.

parameters.title: Include Team Assets
parameters.name: include_team_assets
parameters.tooltip: Include team-level folders and tags.
parameters.description: Include team-level folders and tags.

operations.title: Get Unread Counts
operations.description: Retrieves the unread article count per feed, folder, and tag.

operations.title: Get User Information
operations.description: Retrieves the identity of the Inoreader account the configuration authenticates as. Also used as the health check.

operations.title: Add Subscription
operations.description: Subscribes the account to a feed URL. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

parameters.title: Feed URL
parameters.name: feed_url
parameters.tooltip: Feed URL to subscribe to. The 'feed/' prefix is added for you if missing.
parameters.description: Feed URL to subscribe to, e.g. 'https://example.com/releases.atom'. A numResults of 1 means the feed is subscribed, including when it already was.

operations.title: Edit Subscription
operations.description: Renames a subscription, moves it between folders, or unsubscribes from it. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

parameters.title: Stream ID
parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.tooltip: Feed to edit, e.g. 'feed/https://example.com/releases.atom'.
parameters.description: Feed to edit, e.g. 'feed/https://example.com/releases.atom'. A bare feed URL is accepted.

parameters.title: Action
parameters.name: action
parameters.tooltip: 'edit' applies the title/folder changes below; 'unsubscribe' removes the feed.
parameters.description: 'edit' applies the title and folder changes below; 'unsubscribe' removes the feed from the account.

parameters.title: New Title
parameters.name: title
parameters.tooltip: Rename the subscription.
parameters.description: New display title for the subscription.

parameters.title: Add to Folder
parameters.name: add_to_folder
parameters.tooltip: Folder name, or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.
parameters.description: Folder to add the subscription to. Accepts a plain name or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.

parameters.title: Remove from Folder
parameters.name: remove_from_folder
parameters.tooltip: Folder name, or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.
parameters.description: Folder to remove the subscription from. Accepts a plain name or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.

operations.title: Tag Articles
operations.description: Adds or removes a tag on one or more articles: mark read or unread, star, like, broadcast, or apply a custom folder/tag. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

parameters.title: Article IDs
parameters.name: item_ids
parameters.tooltip: One or more article IDs, comma-separated or as a list.
parameters.description: Article IDs to tag, comma-separated or supplied as a list. All are sent in a single request.

parameters.title: Add Tag
parameters.name: add_tag
parameters.tooltip: System tag to add to each article.
parameters.description: System tag to add to each article.

parameters.title: Add Custom Folder/Tag
parameters.name: add_custom_tag
parameters.tooltip: Custom tag name, or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID. Overrides the selection above.
parameters.description: Custom folder or tag to add. Accepts a plain name or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.

parameters.title: Remove Tag
parameters.name: remove_tag
parameters.tooltip: System tag to remove from each article. Removing 'Read' marks articles unread.
parameters.description: System tag to remove from each article. Removing 'Read' marks the articles unread.

parameters.title: Remove Custom Folder/Tag
parameters.name: remove_custom_tag
parameters.tooltip: Custom tag name, or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID. Overrides the selection above.
parameters.description: Custom folder or tag to remove. Accepts a plain name or a full 'user/-/label/<name>' ID.

operations.title: Mark Stream as Read
operations.description: Marks every article in a stream as read, optionally only those older than a given time. Requires the 'write' OAuth scope.

parameters.title: Stream ID
parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.tooltip: Stream to mark read. Defaults to the full reading list.
parameters.description: Stream to mark read, e.g. 'user/-/label/Patch Intel'. Defaults to the full reading list.

parameters.title: Only Articles Older Than
parameters.name: older_than
parameters.tooltip: Articles published after this datetime stay unread.
parameters.description: Only mark articles published before this datetime. Anything newer stays unread.
